objective: Test whether the exact Yahoo adjusted-close snapshot used by Generation 4 is sufficiently concordant with authenticated Alpaca data for qqq_core_sector_12_6 source-robustness claims. This is not an independent out-of-sample profitability test.

dates.authenticated_overlap_rule: For each symbol, use the later first date and earlier last date across the stored Yahoo series and authenticated Alpaca split-adjusted series. The fully common candidate panel uses the intersection across all symbols and both sources.

yahoo.snapshot: Exact content-addressed Generation 4 private panel; no Yahoo redownload
yahoo.semantics: Adjusted close includes distributions and splits according to Yahoo's provider methodology; the stored response does not expose an independently auditable adjustment formula.

alpaca_split.role: Primary price-feed fidelity series. IEX is a single-exchange feed, so exact close equality with Yahoo is not expected.

alpaca_all.role: Identify distribution-adjustment intervals and provide the candidate-level total-return-like source-concordance diagnostic.

alignment_and_null_policy.timezone: UTC date derived from each provider timestamp; stored Yahoo points already use YYYY-MM-DD
alignment_and_null_policy.chronology: Each source/symbol series must be strictly increasing with no duplicate dates and finite positive closes; any violation fails closed.
alignment_and_null_policy.alignment: Inner-join exact dates only. Never forward-fill, backward-fill, interpolate, splice, or substitute a missing value.
alignment_and_null_policy.return_definition: Natural log of close_t / close_t-1 on adjacent dates in the aligned common-date sequence.
alignment_and_null_policy.distribution_interval_detection: Mark an interval when absolute(Alpaca-all log return minus Alpaca-split log return) exceeds 0.01 basis point (0.000001 return units).
alignment_and_null_policy.ordinary_session_fidelity_sample: Exclude marked distribution-adjustment intervals from the Yahoo-adjusted versus Alpaca-split price-feed fidelity statistics. The output must disclose excluded count, fraction, all excluded dates in JSON, and at most ten example dates in Markdown.
alignment_and_null_policy.reason_for_exclusion: Yahoo adjusted close includes cash distributions while Alpaca split adjustment does not. Keeping those intervals in the price-feed gate would test different economic definitions rather than feed fidelity. The exclusion is frozen before authentication and may not exceed the cap below.
alignment_and_null_policy.candidate_diagnostic: Run the selected candidate and SPY on the exact fully common panel using stored Yahoo adjusted close and Alpaca adjustment=all separately.

decision_rule.pass: All per-symbol chronology, coverage, exclusion-cap, ordinary-session log-return gates, and all candidate-level gates pass.
decision_rule.fail: Any missing source, malformed payload, chronology violation, pagination failure, threshold failure, hash mismatch, or incomplete run produces FAIL_CLOSED. A failure may not be relabeled as source validation.
decision_rule.claims_boundary: A pass supports source concordance over authenticated overlap only. It does not establish future profitability, economic causality, or independence from universe-selection, survivorship, growth-tilt, or multiple-testing bias.

security.credentials: Read only from ignored local environment variables and send only as Alpaca authentication headers.
security.persistence: Never persist credentials, request headers, raw response bodies, or page tokens. Persist only hashes, aggregate metrics, dates, and source metadata.
